facts.headline: There is 1 open repair for 1 unit, the earliest due back 2026-05-31 (1 of them already past the promised date). That repair was due 61 days ago and still has not arrived, so its date is no longer a forecast -- chase it before relying on it. Buying a new one takes about 30 days.
caveats: A repair being open means the purchase order exists, not that the unit has physically reached the vendor -- no dispatch movement is recorded against it.
1 of these repairs is already past the promised return date, so the due date is a plan rather than a commitment.
